name: Implementation Leaderboard
description: Turns recorded results into an honest verdict on which implementation is best, and says so plainly when the result is a tie or the evidence is not comparable.
purpose: Decide from recorded results which implementation is best, or whether they tie.
approach: Compare the recorded scores of the implementations on the same cases and call a winner only when the gap is beyond the noise.
milestones: 1. Ranking correctness: the verdict matches the known right verdict on every pinned result set, ties and different case sets included. [met: 2026-10-26]
measures_of_success: Its verdicts match known rankings on pinned cases and never call a tie a win. Standing conditions: A win is called only outside the noise margin; ties, losses and unmeasured arms are labelled as such; comparison-only arms are never rivals.
parameters: Noise margin and spend tolerance per component.
outputs: A verdict per solution and a ranked board.
usage_notes: The check requires the selected implementation to be the winner or a declared tie with a reason.
